purpose: Fix 1 (decision, 2026-10-01): the compliant-turn admissibility test also counts perceived static obstacles (src/colregs/geometry.py obstacle_room; switch ADMISSIBILITY_STATIC). Diagnosis: the test saw only the map boundary, so near a static obstacle the context said the compliant turn was fine and the R-2 slowdown credit never switched on (L2 head-on 0/20: the policy turned starboard into the gate obstacle, never slowing). This run repeats the exact 2.5 M -> 3.0 M stage-7 continuation that produced the kept 3 M policy, with only fix 1 switched on, so the comparison isolates the fix.
selection: goal - 2 x collision over the development set (120) plus the v3 three-panel development set (150), safety layer off; the 2.5 M start model is evaluated first (under fix 1)
test: the frozen suite and the Paper 2 set on this run's best model (evaluated with fix 1 on, read from config.json), against the kept 3 M policy (sacs0_bl3)
